column2: I can't promise I won't try anything... but I'd be happy if you'd come along.{wait}{clear}
I'm busy right now...{n}
Thank you.{wait}{clear}
I'm busy right now...{wait}{clear}
I see... Then let's make it another time...{wait}{clear}
It's cold today... Aren't you cold?{wait}{clear}
No, I'm fine.{wait}{clear}
You may be fine, but it makes me cold just looking at you. Here...{wait}{clear}
Thank you... Rocus.{wait}{clear}
...I've caused you a lot of trouble... I'm sorry...{wait}{clear}
No, it's all right. Really.{wait}{clear}
Tell me about yourself{n}
About your healing hands...{n}
Please tell me about yourself, Rocus.{wait}{clear}
About me? It isn't interesting... I'm sure.{wait}{clear}
I don't mind... I want to hear it, so won't you tell me?{wait}{clear}
I... was taken in by the Church as a child.{wait}{clear}
Because they discovered the power in these hands...{wait}{clear}
At the Church, I was taught all sorts of things so I could become Pope. Etiquette, and the duties of a Pope.{wait}{clear}
Meanwhile, the bishops around me flattered me in all sorts of ways, since I was the future Pope.{wait}{clear}
Petty things, the kind you use on a kid...{wait}{clear}
Well, back then they fooled me well enough.{wait}{clear}
They may be clergy, but they're human. Nice faces on the outside, and just greedy old men inside.{wait}{clear}
They say all the right things, which makes them far worse than plain villains...{wait}{clear}
While I was fooling and being fooled by people like that, somehow...{wait}{clear}
becoming Pope started to seem ridiculous...{wait}{clear}
Because I felt like I was only being used.{wait}{clear}
So I spent my time idly playing around, and the Vice Pope threw me out of the Holy City...{wait}{clear}
Well, that's about it... A boring story...{wait}{clear}
That's not true... Thank you for telling me.{wait}{clear}By the way... what are your parents doing now, Rocus?{wait}{clear}
Oh, my parents are ordinary people.{wait}{clear}
But we always lived apart...{wait}{clear}
When I met them after I'd grown up, they felt almost like strangers.{wait}{clear}
Even now we hardly see each other, and we have nothing to say to each other...{wait}{clear}
I'm not good with them... those people.{wait}{clear}......{wait}{clear}
Won't you tell me about your healing hands?{wait}{clear}
About these hands, huh...{wait}{clear}
...I first noticed the power in my hands when I was eight or nine, I think...{wait}{clear}
The very first time was a puppy I had... It was barely born, and it got run over by a carriage...{wait}{clear}
It was so badly hurt, I thought there was no saving it.{wait}{clear}
I was so frustrated then...{wait}{clear}
What was it even born for? It was still so little, and it didn't know anything...{wait}{clear}
I couldn't stand it dying like that...{wait}{clear}
But while I was stroking the puppy, its bleeding stopped, and its wounds healed...{wait}{clear}
At first I didn't realize. I was just glad the puppy was well again... that my wish had come true.{wait}{clear}
